mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cage_special_status_snapshot ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, scan_batch_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, shelve_id BIGINT NOT NULL, campus_name VARCHAR(64), room_id BIGINT, room_name VARCHAR(128), position_x INT NOT NULL, position_y INT NOT NULL, position_label VARCHAR(16), status_code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, status_label VARCHAR(64), pi_name VARCHAR(128), department_name VARCHAR(256), project_pi_name VARCHAR(128), detail_name VARCHAR(256), detail_description TEXT, cage_box_qr_code VARCHAR(512), animal_cage_type INT, scanned_at DATETIME NOT NULL, INDEX idx_scan_batch (scan_batch_id), INDEX idx_status_code (status_code), INDEX idx_shelve_id (shelve_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4;
ALTER TABLE cage_special_status_snapshot ADD COLUMN campus_name VARCHAR(64) AFTER shelve_id

INSERT INTO cage_special_status_snapshot ( scan_batch_id, shelve_id, campus_name, room_id, room_name, position_x, position_y, position_label, status_code, status_label, pi_name, department_name, project_pi_name, detail_name, detail_description, cage_box_qr_code, animal_cage_type, scanned_at ) VALUES
( #{row.scanBatchId}, #{row.shelveId}, #{row.campusName}, #{row.roomId}, #{row.roomName}, #{row.positionX}, #{row.positionY}, #{row.positionLabel}, #{row.statusCode}, #{row.statusLabel}, #{row.piName}, #{row.departmentName}, #{row.projectPiName}, #{row.detailName}, #{row.detailDescription}, #{row.cageBoxQrCode}, #{row.animalCageType}, #{row.scannedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT scan_batch_id AS scanBatchId, MAX(scanned_at) AS scannedAt, COUNT(*) AS totalRows FROM cage_special_status_snapshot GROUP BY scan_batch_id ORDER BY MAX(scanned_at) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT status_code AS statusCode, status_label AS statusLabel, COUNT(*) AS count FROM cage_special_status_snapshot WHERE scan_batch_id = #{scanBatchId} AND status_code != 'NORMAL' GROUP BY status_code, status_label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT id, scan_batch_id AS scanBatchId, shelve_id AS shelveId, campus_name AS campusName, room_id AS roomId, room_name AS roomName, position_x AS positionX, position_y AS positionY, position_label AS positionLabel, status_code AS statusCode, status_label AS statusLabel, pi_name AS piName, department_name AS departmentName, project_pi_name AS projectPiName, detail_name AS detailName, detail_description AS detailDescription, cage_box_qr_code AS cageBoxQrCode, animal_cage_type AS animalCageType, scanned_at AS scannedAt FROM cage_special_status_snapshot WHERE scan_batch_id = #{scanBatchId} ORDER BY shelve_id, position_y, position_x
